_source: ANU Programs and Courses — specialisation pages linked from the Master of Computing (https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2026/program/7706XMCOMP).
_note: The 2027 program page links only some of its seven specialisations; the rest come from the 2026 catalogue (MCHL-SPEC). catalogueYear says which year each page came from.

specialisations.title: Artificial Intelligence Specialisation
specialisations.requirementsText:
This Specialisation requires the completion of 24 units, which must include a minimum of 12 units of 8000-level courses.
A maximum of 12 units from the following list:
COMP6262 Logic
COMP6320 Artificial Intelligence
COMP6242 Deep Learning
COMP6670 Introduction to Machine Learning
COMP6528 Computer Vision
A minimum of 12 units from the following list:
COMP8490 Document Analysis
COMP8539 Advanced Topics in Computer Vision
COMP8600 Statistical Machine Learning
COMP8620 Advanced Topics in Artificial Intelligence
COMP8650 Advanced Topics in Machine Learning
COMP8691 Optimisation

specialisations.title: Computational Foundations Specialisation
specialisations.requirementsText:

COMP6361 Principles of Programming Languages
COMP6363 Theory of Computation
COMP8011 Advanced Topics in Formal Methods and Programming Languages
COMP8460 Advanced Algorithms
MATH6114 Number Theory and Cryptography
MATH8343 Foundations of Mathematics
A maximum of 12 units from completion of courses from the following list:
COMP6261 Information Theory
COMP6262 Logic
COMP6466 Algorithms
COMP8712 Compiler Construction

specialisations.title: Data Science Specialisation
specialisations.requirementsText:

COMP6240 Relational Databases
COMP8410 Data Mining
COMP8490 Document Analysis
6 units from completion of courses from the following list:
COMP6434 Data Wrangling
COMP6670 Introduction to Machine Learning
COMP8600 Statistical Machine Learning

specialisations.title: Human-Centred and Creative Computing Specialisation
specialisations.requirementsText:
This specialisation requires the completion of 24 units, which must include a minimum of 12 units of 8000-level courses:
The 24 units must consist of:
COMP6390 Human-Computer Interaction
AND
A minimum of 12 units from the following list:
COMP8020 Advanced Topics in Human-Centred and Creative Computing
COMP8350 Sound and Music Computing
COMP8539 Advanced Topics in Computer Vision
COMP8610 Computer Graphics
AND
A maximum of 6 units from completion of courses from the following list:
COMP6528 Computer Vision
COMP6540 Game Development
COMP6720 Art and Interaction Computing

specialisations.title: Software Development Specialisation
specialisations.requirementsText:
This specialisation requires the completion of 24 units, which must consist of a minimum of 12 units of 8000-level courses.
The 24 units must consist of:
12 units from completion of the following compulsory courses:
COMP6120 Software Engineering (6 units)
ENGN8100 Introduction to Systems Engineering (6 units)
6 units from completion of an 8000-level course from the subject area COMP Computing, excluding the project courses (COMP8715, COMP8800, COMP8830).
A maximum of 12 units from completion of courses from the following list:
COMP6240 Relational Databases (6 units)
COMP6331 Computer Networks (6 units)
COMP6390 Human-Computer Interaction (6 units)
INFS8004 Enterprise Systems and Strategy (6 units)
INFS8205 Digital Strategy, Executive and Operations (6 units)
LAWS8445 Information Technology Law (6 units)
MGMT7020 Technology and Project Management (6 units)
REGN8014 Contemporary Issues in Technology Governance (6 units)
Note: MCOMP students who complete COMP6120 as part of their program rules need to replace it with 6 units of 6000/8000 COMP.
